head_commit.message:
Populate the agents overview from background tool responses (#46946)

## Why

Tool responses can arrive without a `thread/started` notification, leaving background threads missing from the agents overview.

## What changed

Register metadata returned by background thread creation, forking, and resumption as a fallback, then refresh and repaint the overview. Clear turn history before registration and exclude ephemeral threads.

Preserve existing metadata and track archived or deleted threads so delayed tool responses cannot restore removed rows. Clear that removal tracking when a thread starts or is unarchived.

## Testing

Extend tests to cover tool-created and forked thread registration, missing start notifications, and delayed responses alongside metadata refreshes and lifecycle removals.

GitOrigin-RevId: a6f892f1c839dc69fac24b00c34927a7c5f8ce84

head_commit.message:
Add independent TUI rendering toggles for Mermaid, math, and tables (#46938)

## What changed

Add `tui.rendering.mermaid`, `tui.rendering.math`, and `tui.rendering.tables`, all enabled by default and independent of animation settings. Disable individual renderers to display their source instead of diagrams, Unicode math, or formatted tables.

Apply preferences to streaming and completed responses, startup previews, and session changes. When table rendering is disabled, preserve pipe syntax, cell markup, and enclosing Markdown fences. Keep HTML clipboard formatting independent of terminal rendering preferences.

## Testing

Add coverage for individual defaults, source preservation, nested table fences, session settings, and clipboard behavior. Verify incremental rendering and emitted output match completed rendering across all eight toggle combinations.

GitOrigin-RevId: 48d765eac20a82881eed94f186bf5b025ff4f0db
